method: Web-derived paraphrased observations only; blocked originals are not archived sources. No retrieved snippets substituted for original files.

sources.observation: Chapter index identifies nine sections; index is not full sign-rule text.
Section 1185.002 states a permit precedes sign installation/erection; reconcile village zoning certificate and county building sign application.

Section 1185.02 contains frontage-dependent area/height, glare, projection and narrow service-station freestanding provisions. Raw phrase storage frontage is an unresolved wording anomaly; do not silently replace with store frontage or apply numeric limits to every sign.
Section 1185.06 makes special-purpose/event temporary signs discretionary and permit-based; no fixed duration or automatic permission inferred.

Chapter 1186 separately addresses sidewalk cafe and sandwich boards. Section 1186.03 text expressly covers sidewalk cafe; do not extrapolate that sentence alone to all sandwich-board cases. Remaining definitions, location, insurance and fees need review.

Chapter 711 separately identifies expressway advertising certificate/nonconforming/standards provisions. Do not treat Chapter 1185 alone as exhaustive billboard regulation; litigation and current legislation require separate review.

IBI page links existing ezTrak users to portal and new-user instructions. Provider homepage separately announces Ohio application migration effective September 14, 2026. Portal identity does not prove St. Bernard contract, permit issuer, or inspector.

version_review: Responses at latest URLs show 2024-04, 2026-01 and 2026-02 labels; retrieval/cache variation or inconsistent publisher versions unresolved. Do not infer legislative differences from labels alone.
electrical_review: Village county transfer, 1305.01(e) IBI routing and provider Ohio ezTrak migration must be reconciled with current St. Bernard service-area/delegation evidence. Shared portal does not establish county replacement of IBI.
